sanskrit_verse:
निर्गुणोऽपि यथा स्त्रीणां पूज्य एव पतिः सदा।
प्रजानां विगुणोऽप्येवं पूज्य एव नराधिपः॥
transliteration: nirguṇo'pi yathā strīṇāṃ pūjya eva patiḥ sadā | prajānāṃ viguṇo'pyevaṃ pūjya eva narādhipaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Just as a husband, though devoid of personal merit, is eternally worshipful to women, so too is the ruler of men ever worshipful to his subjects, even if he lacks virtue.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from position, not personal perfection
Causation arises through alignment with dharma, not individual conduct alone
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by role, not subjective worthiness
Restoration logic centers on sustaining social order via reverence for established roles
Consciousness alignment requires honoring divinely ordained hierarchies regardless of apparent faults
executable_legal_axioms: IF Entity holds positional authority THEN Entity must be honored irrespective of personal virtue
IF Social stability depends on reverence for leadership THEN Disrespect toward leader constitutes violation of dharma
IF Leadership role exists THEN Subject population has duty to uphold respect for that role
IF Individual acts contrary to positional dharma THEN Realignment protocols activate automatically without punitive intent
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that legitimacy of governance does not depend upon moral impeccability of rulers. The court must recognize and enforce respect due to constitutional offices, ensuring societal continuity over subjective evaluations of character.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causal efficacy stems from honoring sacred roles rather than judging individual behavior. Anupūrvaśaḥ demonstrates sequential breakdown of order when respect for rulers falters. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring recognition of positional sanctity, not punishing perceived inadequacies. Non-punitive reality rule affirms correction occurs through reaffirming rightful place, not inflicting consequences.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate public rituals affirming sovereignty of ruling office
Realign subject consciousness through education emphasizing dharmic duty to honor leadership
Activate community completion processes wherein disrespect is dissolved through renewed commitment to collective dharma
Restore integrity of governance structure by reestablishing ceremonial recognition of ruler's inherent dignity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored through recognition of positional divinity; justice aligns consciousness with eternal order; reality remains non-punitive; consciousness itself adjudicates truth.
